reader_summary.headline: Last week.
reader_summary.overview: Last week, the senseless and tragic events at the Tree of Life Synagogue in Pittsburgh left me and many others asking questions about our world today. This one hit a little closer to home for me than the many other equally terrible events that have occurred because my mother grew up in Squirrel Hill..

key_points.text: This one hit a little closer to home for me than the many other equally terrible events that have occurred because my mother grew up in Squirrel Hill..
Our family is a generation removed and not closely connected to the town anymore.
Andy is the President of CIM Investment Management in Pittsburgh, where he has worked for a quarter-century and oversees $1.4 billion.
